title: Bohr orbits grow as n²
caption: In the Bohr model r_n = n²a₀ with a₀ = 0.0529 nm. The n = 2 orbit is four times the ground-state radius, 0.212 nm, and the electron there moves at half the speed (v ∝ 1/n).
alt: Bar chart of Bohr orbit radii: 0.053, 0.212, 0.476 and 0.846 nanometres for n = 1 to 4.
description: The speed falls as 1/n: 2.19 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ for n = 1, 1.09 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ for n = 2.
